caveats: Proposals are unapproved and must not be applied without authenticated administrator review, field-level provenance, source audits and canonical duplicate checks.
A single Polimi 2027/28 call has five named funding tiers; do not treat the 64 individual awards as 64 scholarship programmes.
HEC Paris MBA scholarship page includes several named awards; generic published HEC record must be reconciled before separate new records.
No IELTS/TOEFL/SAT thresholds assigned where scholarship-specific official evidence does not specify a score.
Deadlines for 2026/27 are historical where already closed; do not silently roll them forward.
No archival recommendation based only on failed HTTP checks.
